# CLI reference

The crash-test lab for conversational AI agents.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `-v, --verbose`: Show harness logs (-vv: debug).  [default: 0]

* `mine`: Mine production logs into failure clusters...
* `doctor`: Check keys, audio dependencies, ports and...

* `fix`: Generate and validate prompt patches for a...

## `hecklr version`

Print the installed Hecklr version.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr version [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr init`

Interactive setup: write hecklr.yaml, a starter world, scenarios and personas.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr init [OPTIONS] [directory]
```

**Arguments**:

* `directory`: Project directory; created if missing.  [default: .]

**Options**:

* `-y, --yes`: Accept every default; never prompt.
* `--agent-url <str>`: Agent endpoint; probed to pick the adapter.
* `--adapter <python|http|openai-compatible>`: Adapter type; `python` writes an in-process starter agent.
* `--agent-model <str>`: Model name an openai-compatible agent expects.
* `--agent-name <str>`: Agent name in hecklr.yaml.
* `--simulator-model <str>`: Simulator model, provider/model.
* `--judge-model <str>`: Judge model, provider/model.
* `--force / --no-force`: Overwrite existing starter files.  [default: no-force]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr run`

Run a suite against the agent and write results.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr run [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `-s, --suite <str>`: Suite defined in hecklr.yaml.  [default: ci]
* `--channels <str>`: Channels to run, e.g. `--channels chat` (repeat or comma-separate).
* `--trials <int range>`: Trials per scenario x persona x channel.  [x&gt;=1]
* `--budget-usd <float range>`: Hard cost cap in USD (overrides budget.usd).  [x&gt;=0]
* `--seed <int>`: Root seed (overrides seed).
* `--adaptive / --no-adaptive`: Add up to 50% more trials where results are uncertain or flipped vs the baseline; each extra trial of a scenario runs once per persona x channel.
* `--baseline <str>`: Run id of the stored baseline to compare against later.
* `--output-dir <path>`: Where runs and the response cache go (overrides output_dir).
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr compare`

Statistical comparison of two runs.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr compare [OPTIONS] {baseline} [candidate]
```

**Arguments**:

* `baseline`: Baseline run: an id, `latest` or `baseline` (of the candidate).  [required]
* `candidate`: Candidate run: an id or `latest`.  [default: latest]

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `-f, --format <terminal|md|html|json|junit>`: Output format.  [default: terminal]
* `--out <path>`: Write to this file .
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr gate`

Compare against the stored baseline and set the CI exit code.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr gate [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `-s, --suite <str>`: Gate the latest run of this suite.
* `--candidate <str>`: Candidate run: an id or `latest`.  [default: latest]
* `--baseline <str>`: Baseline run: an id, or `baseline` (the candidate&#x27;s recorded baseline, else the newest earlier completed run of its suite).  [default: baseline]
* `--on-inconclusive <fail|pass>`: Exit code of an inconclusive verdict .
* `--missing-baseline <error|pass>`: With no baseline run at all: `error` exits 3; `pass` reports the candidate alone and exits 0 when the candidate itself is sound.  [default: error]
* `--out-dir <path>`: Where the reports go .
* `--report-url <str>`: Link to the full report, shown in the comment.
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr report`

Build HTML, Markdown, JSON or JUnit output for a run.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr report [OPTIONS] [run]
```

**Arguments**:

* `run`: Run id or `latest`.  [default: latest]

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `-f, --format <md|html|json|junit>`: Formats to write (repeatable) .
* `--baseline <str>`: Compare with this run (an id or `baseline`) .
* `--out-dir <path>`: Directory for the files .
* `--open`: Open the HTML report in a browser.
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr calibrate`

Self-tests: A/A false-positive rate, judge agreement, voice loopback.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr calibrate [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `--aa`: A/A self-test: false-alarm rate (SC5).
* `--judges`: Judge agreement with human labels (SC7).
* `--voice-loopback`: Voice timing loopback (SC4).
* `-s, --suite <str>`: Suite for --aa runs.  [default: ci]
* `--trials <int range>`: Trials per cell for --aa runs.  [x&gt;=1]
* `--seed <int>`: Root seed of the first --aa run; the second uses seed+1.
* `--runs <str>`: --aa: compare these two stored runs instead of running (give twice).
* `--replicates <int range>`: --aa: simulated A/A comparisons (0 skips the simulation).  [default: 200; x&gt;=0]
* `--labels <file>`: --judges: human labels, JSONL.
* `--run <str>`: --judges: runs whose judge grades were labeled .
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr replay`

Convert real transcripts into replay scenarios.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr replay [OPTIONS] {transcripts}
```

**Arguments**:

* `transcripts`: JSONL file, one conversation a line.  [required]

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `--out <path>`: Directory for the scenario files .
* `--persona <str>`: Persona the replays run with .
* `--model <str>`: Extraction model .
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr mine`

Mine production logs into failure clusters and proposed scenarios.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr mine [OPTIONS] {logs}
```

**Arguments**:

* `logs`: Log export to mine.  [required]

**Options**:

* `-f, --format <jsonl|otel|langfuse|langsmith|csv>`: Format of LOGS.  [default: jsonl]
* `--mapping <file>`: CSV column mapping (YAML), for csv.
* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `--out <path>`: Directory for the results .
* `--model <str>`: Model for labels and scenarios .
* `--no-model`: No LLM: keyword labels, no proposed scenarios.
* `--embedder <hashing|openai>`: How failure summaries are embedded.  [default: hashing]
* `--judge <str>`: Judge every conversation on this rubric (repeatable), e.g. resolved.
* `--llm-scrub / --no-llm-scrub`: Also ask the model for PII the patterns missed (names).  [default: no-llm-scrub]
* `--llm-summaries / --no-llm-summaries`: Cluster LLM-written root causes instead of transcript text.  [default: no-llm-summaries]
* `--presidio / --no-presidio`: Also scrub with Presidio (hecklr-mine).  [default: no-presidio]
* `--persona <str>`: Persona of the proposed scenarios .
* `--min-cluster-size <int range>`: Smallest cluster .  [x&gt;=2]
* `--dedup-threshold <float range>`: Similarity that makes a duplicate.  [default: 0.9; 0.0&lt;=x&lt;=1.0]
* `--budget-usd <float range>`: Spending cap . Checked before each model call, so the calls already in flight (up to 8) can overshoot it slightly.  [x&gt;=0.0]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr ui`

Start the local web UI.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr ui [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `--host <str>`: Interface to bind; the UI has no login, keep it local.  [default: 127.0.0.1]
* `--port <int>`: Port to serve on.  [default: 8484]
* `--user <str>`: Default labeler and reviewer name .
* `--open / --no-open`: Open the UI in a browser.  [default: open]
* `--dev / --no-dev`: Serve the API only, for `npm run dev` in ui/ (it proxies /api).  [default: no-dev]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

## `hecklr github`

GitHub Action plumbing.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr github [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

**Options**:

* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

**Commands**:

* `fetch-baseline`: Download the branch&#x27;s newest baseline run...
* `latest-run`: Output ``run-id`` and ``status`` of the...
* `comment`: Create or update the suite&#x27;s sticky PR...

### `hecklr github fetch-baseline`

Download the branch&#x27;s newest baseline run into the run store; output ``run-id``.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr github fetch-baseline [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `--repo <str>`: owner/name.  [env var: GITHUB_REPOSITORY; required]
* `--name <str>`: Baseline artifact name.  [required]
* `--branch <str>`: Branch whose runs store the baseline.  [required]
* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `hecklr github latest-run`

Output ``run-id`` and ``status`` of the newest finished run of a suite.

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr github latest-run [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `-s, --suite <str>`: Suite of the run.  [required]
* `--since <str>`: Only runs created at this ISO 8601 time with a time zone or later, e.g. the start of the job&#x27;s `hecklr run`, so a fetched baseline is never taken for the run.
* `-c, --config <path>`: Path to hecklr.yaml.  [default: hecklr.yaml]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.

### `hecklr github comment`

Create or update the suite&#x27;s sticky PR comment; output ``comment`` (created/updated).

**Usage**:

```console
$ hecklr github comment [OPTIONS]
```

**Options**:

* `--repo <str>`: owner/name.  [env var: GITHUB_REPOSITORY; required]
* `--pr <int>`: Pull request number.  [required]
* `-s, --suite <str>`: Suite the comment is about.  [required]
* `--body-file <path>`: Markdown body; missing means no report.
* `--fallback <str>`: Body when the body file is missing (the gate never ran).  [default: Hecklr could not produce a report; see the workflow logs.]
* `--help`: Show this message and exit.
